content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle each provide a similar promise: an easy way to sell digital products online with integrated payment processing. However, they differ fundamentally in their reach and accessibility. Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195, which inherently limits many creators. PayPal may be available, but its strict policies can lead to account suspensions that freeze funds for up to 180 days without appeal. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have similar limitations, making it nearly impossible for creators in restricted regions to utilize their services. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators by offering ownership and control over their sales process without dependencies on third-party platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The conventional payment processors often exclude creators from certain countries based on regulatory risks or market presence. This exclusion prevents many from monetizing their digital products effectively. For example, PayPal restricts operations in several countries, causing frustration among creators who cannot access their funds. Stripe similarly limits its services to a select number of countries, leaving a vast majority without viable options. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure transcends these barriers. It allows creators to set up their own payment systems utilizing tools like NOWPayments, ensuring they can accept cryptocurrency payments without geographical restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When evaluating payment processors, speed and fees are critical factors. Traditional platforms like PayPal and Stripe often have hidden costs and lengthy transaction times. For instance, PayPal may impose fees on each transaction, plus currency conversion fees, which can accumulate quickly. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a low 0.5% fee with instant payment confirmations, allowing creators to receive their funds much faster. Additionally, utilizing a sovereign infrastructure means avoiding the monthly or annual subscriptions that other platforms impose, making it a more cost-effective solution in the long run.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you complete control over your digital sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a crucial factor that distinguishes sovereign commerce infrastructure from traditional platforms. With Stripe or PayPal, creators often relinquish control over their customer data and transaction flow. Conversely, platforms like COREMERCH enable full data ownership, ensuring creators can manage their sales process entirely. This infrastructure automates payment verification and product delivery, offering seamless customer experiences. With the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can deploy a fully functional online store that delivers products instantly without ongoing reliance on external platforms, thus ensuring that they maintain autonomy over their business.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs and location. If you're in a restricted country and looking for a reliable solution, the Edge Commerce Stack is highly recommended. Priced at $197, it can be deployed within 48 hours and allows you to host up to five products with integrated payment processing. Alternatively, if you're just starting, consider the Sovereign Starter Stack, which provides a basic setup for $97. Assessing your requirements and future growth potential will guide you toward the most suitable option.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe isn't available in your country, the best alternative is to utilize sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH. It allows you to set up an online store with automatic crypto payment processing while maintaining full control over your data and transactions. This solution is specifically designed for creators in regions where conventional platforms are inaccessible.

You can explore more options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and empower your digital sales independently.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
